subject: EmberTech strategic onramp: combined credits + discount request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Quick summary: EmberTech (AI infra startup, Series B) is pushing to go live with a pilot next month. They like our latency and multi-environment story, but procurement says they need a lower entry cost to get the execs comfortable. 

Ask: Approval to offer a one-time package: 3-month trial extension on hosted API, $25,000 platform credits (applied to usage), and a 15% introductory subscription discount for the first 12 months if they sign a 12-month commitment at the end of the pilot. This is outside our standard promo caps and needs exec approval.

Why: Close velocity is high — they’ve completed the technical POC and forecast $600k ARR within 12 months if pilot converts. Competitor (XCloud) gave a smaller credit but no latency guarantees; EmberTech values our SLA/observability features.

Financials attached (discount_calc_sheet.xlsx) and proposed offer doc (EmberTech_Onramp_Proposal_v1.pdf). I model that even with the credits + discount the NPV over 12 months is positive given expected usage and expansion.

Timeline: EmberTech needs an answer by EOD Wed 11/03 to meet their procurement window.

Next steps I recommend:
- Exec signoff on exception today or tomorrow
- Legal to push a short SOW addendum and credit schedule to procurement
- Finance to confirm credit burn rules and revenue recognition treatment

Happy to jump on a quick 20m if you want the numbers walked through.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: EmberTech_Onramp_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal), discount_calc_sheet.xlsx (model)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Thanks Ben — quick questions before I commit:

1) Can you confirm the expected payback / ARR motion if they convert? You mentioned ~$600k ARR; I need the ARR by month 6 and estimated churn assumptions used in the model.
2) Are the credits one-time and non-refundable? We should ensure clear burn rules in the SOW.
3) Any legal flags on term/auto-renew? Do we require an upfront payment or is the contract fully usage-based?

If the math looks solid and Finance signs off on the credit accounting, I’m OK with the package as a strategic onramp — provided we get standard fallback clauses (revert pricing after pilot if usage < threshold).

Please reply with the 3 bullets so I can sign off today.

-Markus

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary: EmberTech (AI infra startup, Series B) is pushing to go live with a pilot next month. They like our latency and multi-environment story, but procurement says they need a lower entry cost to get the execs comfortable.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Markus — answers below and I attached the updated calc sheet with month-by-month ARR: see tab "ARR_build".

1) Payback / ARR: If they convert at end of pilot to a 12-month committed plan we project: month 3 ARR ~ $42k; month 6 ARR ~ $180k; run-rate at month 12 ~ $600k. Assumptions: 20% growth during pilot (up to month 3), 10% m/m thereafter, and 10% logo churn/year. If they only convert with 6 months commit, NPV still positive.

2) Credits: one-time, non-refundable, expire at the end of the 3-month trial. Credits apply only to hosted API usage and do not cover dedicated deployment or professional services. We will include explicit burn rules in the SOW.

3) Legal / payment: contract will be usage-based during trial; procurement prefers the option of a pre-paid commitment at conversion. We propose a 12-month committed subscription with standard auto-renew and a 30-day termination window after initial term with service-level exceptions. Legal has flagged that we should avoid custom auto-renew wording — will use standard clause in SOW addendum.

I recommend we proceed. Finance reviewed the model verbally and is comfortable with the accounting treatment; they asked to confirm the credit write-down schedule once the SOW is executed.

If you approve, I will send a single-page approval note for exec signature and loop Legal to draft the addendum.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Quick note from Legal (summarized):
- Credits: include a redemption matrix and explicit exclusions (no transfer to third-parties, no cover for professional services).
- Discount: label as "introductory" with an explicit end date and define the baseline list price.
- Term: we will keep standard auto-renew but add a 30-day notice window.

Jordan, finance: please confirm the P&L and credit amortization approach — we need the confirmation in writing so Markus can sign off.

If Finance + Markus approve, Legal will prepare the SOW addendum and I will send it to procurement.

-Marissa

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 01:26 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> I recommend we proceed. Finance reviewed the model verbally and is comfortable with the accounting treatment; they asked to confirm the credit write-down schedule once the SOW is executed.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Confirmed — Finance reviewed and endorses with the following conditions:
- Credits will be recognized as deferred revenue at grant and amortized as usage is consumed; Finance will prepare the write-down schedule after we receive the signed SOW.
- We want a clause that prevents stacking other promotional credits within the first 12 months (no double-dipping).
- Approve $25k credits + 15% discount contingent on receiving the signed SOW within 45 days of pilot start.

With those conditions, I authorize exec approval. Markus, you have green light from our side.

-Jordan

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa@embertech.com>, Procurement <procurement@embertech.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 16:38:00 -0800
Subject: RE: EmberTech request: combined 3mo trial + $25k credits + 15% intro discount - asking for exec signoff

Ben / team / Alyssa — thank you for the patience. After reviewing the model and conditions from Legal and Finance I approve the EmberTech onramp package:

- 3-month hosted API trial extension
- $25,000 one-time usage credits (non-transferable, expire at end of trial)
- 15% introductory discount on first 12 months post-conversion if a 12-month commitment is signed within 45 days of pilot start

Conditions:
1) Legal will prepare the SOW addendum incorporating the redemption matrix, exclusions, and auto-renew language.
2) Finance will prepare the credit amortization schedule and include the no-stacking clause.
3) Offer expires if SOW not signed within 45 days of pilot start.

Alyssa: please confirm acceptance of these terms and I will ask Legal to circulate the SOW addendum and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow. Looking forward to having EmberTech onboarded.

-Markus
